description: Unit tests for port_symlink.py, testing symlink creation, reading, deletion, and directory traversal functions within the starboard.tools package.

classes.name: PortSymlinkTest
classes.description: Test case class for testing symlink operations and directory traversal functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment with temporary directories and symlinks.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up temporary directories after tests.

methods.name: testSanity
methods.description: Checks that temporary directories and symlinks are created correctly.

methods.name: testReadSymlinkNormalPath
methods.description: Verifies reading a normal directory path returns None.

methods.name: testSymlinkPath
methods.description: Checks that symlink points correctly to the target directory.

methods.name: testRelativeSymlinkPath
methods.description: Tests creation and reading of a relative symlink.

methods.name: testRmtreeRemovesLink
methods.description: Ensures Rmtree removes symlink but not the target directory.

methods.name: testRmtreeRemovesBrokenLink
methods.description: Checks Rmtree handles broken symlinks correctly.

methods.name: testRmtreeDoesNotFollowSymlinks
methods.description: Ensures Rmtree deletes symlink without deleting target files.

methods.name: _MakeDirs
methods.description: Creates directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: _PathTypeToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of path type: link, dir, or file.

methods.name: _GetAllPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects all paths in directory, following symlinks based on parameter.

methods.name: _IsSamePath
methods.description: Checks if two paths refer to the same file or directory.
